title: Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.03087v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit systematic biases across demographic groups. Auditing is proposed as an accountability tool for black-box LLM applications, but suffers from resource-intensive query access. We conceptualise auditing as uncertainty estimation over a target fairness metric and introduce BAFA, the Bounded Active Fairness Auditor for query-efficient auditing of black-box LLMs. BAFA maintains a version space of surrogate models consistent with queried scores and computes uncertainty intervals for fairness metrics (e.g., $\Delta$ AUC) via constrained empirical risk minimisation. Active query selection narrows these intervals to reduce estimation error. We evaluate BAFA on two standard fairness dataset case studies: \textsc{CivilComments} and \textsc{Bias-in-Bios}, comparing against stratified sampling, power sampling, and ablations. translated_title: 有本事就来审计我：黑盒大语言模型的查询高效主动公平性审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在不同人口群体间表现出系统性偏差。审计被提出作为黑盒LLM应用的问责工具，但其依赖于资源密集型的查询访问。我们将审计概念化为对目标公平性指标的不确定性估计，并提出了BAFA（有界主动公平性审计器），用于对黑盒LLM进行查询高效的审计。BAFA维护一个与已查询得分一致的代理模型版本空间，并通过约束经验风险最小化计算公平性指标（如Δ AUC）的不确定性区间。主动查询选择能够缩小这些区间，从而降低估计误差。我们在两个标准公平性数据集案例研究上评估了BAFA：CivilComments和Bias-in-Bios，并与分层采样、功效采样及消融实验进行了比较。BAFA能够以比静态方法少达40倍的查询量达到目标误差阈值。
tldr: 提出BAFA框架，将黑盒大语言模型的公平性审计概念化为不确定性估计问题，通过维护代理模型版本空间和主动查询选择，以最多40倍更少的查询量达到目标误差阈值。
